# Input group

An input with addons inside its border: icons, text, buttons.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Accessible first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Accessible first:** A value with a unit or currency, with the label still above the field. Not for separate fields.

- **Use it when:** A search with an icon and a clear button, a value with a unit or currency.
- **Not when:** Controls that are separate fields (lay them out with field).

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): A plain field.

## Why it works this way

Input group looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Input group, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-people-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What accessibility level do we commit to?</b><code>people.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">AAA</div><p>AAA where it applies; nobody is left out.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: A currency sign before the amount, with the label still above the field.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: A unit after the value, as a word people can read, with the label still above the field.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: The label stays above the field, outside it, always visible.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Hints and errors sit in the field layout, in the same place on every question.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: danger</code> <code>Button: focus</code> <code>Button: disabled</code> <code>Field: vertical</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">4</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 15 answers that follow from it: <b>A ratio, line heights in proportion</b>, <b>Neutrals and one brand ramp</b>, <b>Nothing</b>, and 12 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main task?</b><code>tasks.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Complete a form</div><p>People must finish the form.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: A currency sign before the amount, with the label still above the field.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Field: vertical</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>and 6 answers that follow from it: <b>Completion without errors</b>, <b>A task that fails</b>, <b>One sitting</b>, and 3 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do icons do?</b><code>iconography.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Actions and status</div><p>Icons support words; they never replace them.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: A unit after the value, as a word people can read, with the label still above the field.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-voice-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which kinds of copy does it need?</b><code>voice.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Labels, messages and help</div><p>Hints and help text carry people through each step.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Hints and errors sit in the field layout, in the same place on every question.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Addon buttons have names; icons that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input-group
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
